title: WordJS theme.json layout block (v2)
description: Structure config for the public shell. Every key is optional; an absent key (or an absent layout block) keeps the current default rendering exactly.

variant.description: classic = current markup unchanged; centered = logo centered on top, nav in a row below; minimal = logo + hamburger only (nav always in the mobile panel). Default: classic.

sticky.description: false = static header in flow (no fixed positioning and no main offset). Default: true.

transparent.description: true = header without background over the start of the page until the first scroll (background returns with data-scrolled). Default: false.

variant.description: columns = current column grid; minimal = a single row: copyright + socials, no column grid. Default: columns.

columns.description: Column count for the footer grid; only applies when variant is "columns". Default: 4.

sidebar.description: true is equivalent to { "position": "right" } (back-compat with the existing boolean form).

containerWidth.description: CSS length capping the main column (existing key, kept as-is).
